name: Finger of Death

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Con save: 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage, half on a success; a Humanoid it kills rises as your Zombie.
text: A creature you can see in range makes a Constitution save, taking 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A Humanoid killed by it rises at the start of your next turn as a Zombie that obeys your spoken orders.
